SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Pollution.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Pollution.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Pollution.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Pollution.

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Human Breathing System? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Human Breathing System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Human Breathing System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Human Breathing System.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Classification of Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Classification of Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Classification of Plants.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Classification of Plants.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Classification of Plants.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat transfer? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat transfer.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat transfer.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat transfer.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Heat transfer.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Sound Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Heat transfer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Classification of Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Human Breathing System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. C — Glucose and oxygen

7. A — newton (N)

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing System.
